risk_if_not_implemented: Without Post-Quantum Cryptography Exposure, sensitive data with long confidentiality lifetimes remains protected only by quantum-vulnerable cryptography, exposing it to future decryption. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unaddressed Security / Compliance Exposure (R-GV-2), Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care (R-GV-9), Long-Term Confidentiality Loss from Cryptographic Obsolescence (R-IP-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Data Quality Degradation / Data Poisoning (MT-12), Harvest Now / Decrypt Later (HNDL) (MT-28), Cryptographic Compromise / Cryptanalytic Capability Advancement (MT-31).

compensating_control_1.name: Vulnerability Ranking
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to identify and assign a risk ranking to newly discovered security vulnerabilities using reputable outside sources for security vulnerability information.
compensating_control_1.justification: Vulnerability Ranking (VPM-05) provides vulnerability management that compensates for the absence of Post-Quantum Cryptography Exposure (QTS-07.2) by reducing the exploitable attack surface by addressing known weaknesses and prioritizing critical remediations. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Risk-Based Security Categorization
compensating_control_2.description:
Mechanisms exist to categorize Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) in accordance with applicable laws, regulations and contractual obligations that:
(1) Document the security categorization results (including supporting rationale) in the security plan for systems; and
(2) Ensure the security categorization decision is reviewed and approved by the asset owner.
compensating_control_2.justification: Risk-Based Security Categorization (RSK-07) provides risk identification and prioritization that compensates for the absence of Post-Quantum Cryptography Exposure (QTS-07.2) by enabling informed decisions about where to focus resources to manage residual exposure. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
